close_reason: Opinion: variable naming taste, no engineering consequence
description: In email_matches_condition, the pre-declared binding 'let on_demand: HashSet<&Id>;' exists purely to satisfy the borrow checker (the set must outlive the match arm that builds it). The name 'on_demand' describes the call-site timing but not the mechanical reason for the declaration, so a reader unfamiliar with this Rust pattern has to figure out why the variable is hoisted. Suggested rewrite: rename to 'built' or 'scratch_set' and add a one-line comment: '// Declared here so it outlives the match arm.' This makes the intent explicit without requiring knowledge of NLL limitations.
title: on_demand borrow-lifter name obscures pattern
